rust_summary: a world warp (`native_world_warp`): WGSL every terrain and entity vertex goes through, with an optional per-pixel stage for terrain.
doc_summary: a world warp through `native_world_warp`: once a frame a client mod may give WGSL (`world_warp(pos, section) -> Warped`, and optionally `world_fragment(f) -> Painted` after a line `// [fragments]`) that every terrain vertex, far terrain's tiles included, and entity vertex goes through, with sixteen floats it reads as `warp.params`. While it is on the frame culls nothing by where it was. A frame without one costs nothing more ([World warps](#world-warps)). Bundles need "hooks": @API:world_warp@.
